en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small European village street with fenced front gardens, simple two‑storey houses with tiled roofs, and low hills in the background. On the right side stands a larger building with people gathered in front, likely a shop or inn. The printed red caption at the bottom left reads "Gruss aus Andritz," and at the bottom right "Anton Engenhard jun. Gemischtwaren-Handlung."
